en.why: Macro paper with depth of field makes a few thin lines the subject, so the viewer sees how the logo is drawn before seeing the finished mark. Four camera positions cut at 1.9s, 3.4s and 4.7s, each showing one thing (ring, meridian, letters, fill), and the three cut points set the rhythm. After the hard cut to the flat logo it defocuses into the paper over 0.9s (moving up 90px) and the date and URL type on below it once the defocus has finished, so the two never overlap and the eye does not have to move. The whole film has one accent color, used only for the meridian, the 26 and the URL.
spec: Timing

Film 11s. Hard cuts at 1.9s, 3.4s and 4.7s, and to the flat logo at 5.8s. A thin pen draws the ring 0–2.6s (55% to closed) and a blue pen the meridian 2.3–3.2s. The 10 skeletons start from 3.0s to 4.78s, 0.16–0.22s apart, 0.3–0.55s each. The heavy pen fills 4.5–5.755s, characters 0.075s apart, 0.42s each. Flat logo 5.8–7.0s, defocus 7.0–7.9s, the lockup moves up 90px as it defocuses, date types from 7.75s, URL from 8.15s, held to 11s. The paper texture and guides are on screen from frame 0 with no fade-in
Easing

Ring pen none (constant speed); meridian and letter skeletons power1.inOut; heavy fill power2.out; guides power2.out; camera constant speed (none) in takes 1, 2 and 3, power3.out in take 4; logo defocus power2.inOut; date and URL expo.out (0.5s per character, 0.035s apart, each character rising 8px from below and going from 6px blur to sharp)
Camera

Perspective 1500px, the paper tilted about a horizontal axis. Take 1 zoom 5.2→4.4, tilt 58°→55°, roll −10°→−6°, the camera aimed 4° of arc ahead of the pen tip so the tip stays near the middle of the frame (about 45% of the frame height); take 2 zoom 2.5→2.2, tilt 50°→47°; take 3 zoom 1.9→1.75, tilt 55°→52°, the camera sliding right aimed about 25 units left of the letter being drawn, so the pen tip sits in the middle-right of the frame; take 4 zoom 1.15→0.78, tilt 52°→46°, pulling back and sliding right while the fill runs, with the whole mark inside the frame at its start and the right edge of the 6 about 280px inside the frame at the end. An extra 1.00→1.02 slow push runs across all four takes. Depth of field uses four identical copies of the plane blurred 0, 2.4, 6 and 12px, with a focus band half-width of 150, 190, 160 and 330px (takes 1 to 4)
Subject

Plane units: 1 unit = 2.8px, x-height 100 units (280px). Mark: an ink ring plus a blue meridian ellipse (radius 66, half-width 30 units); wordmark meridian plus a blue 26, 10 characters built from arcs and straight lines. Thin pen 0.7 units (about 2px), heavy pen 16 units (about 45px) for letters and 13 units for the ring and meridian. 36 guide strokes: 4 horizontal rulings, 3 concentric circles, 3 diagonals, 2 cross lines, the left and right edge of every character and the bounding circle of each round letter, plus baseline ticks every 6 units and registration crosses
Sync

Each character's guides are drawn 0.8–0.9s before its skeleton; each character's heavy stroke starts only after its own skeleton is done (the m skeleton ends at 3.55s and its fill starts at 4.66s; the 6 skeleton ends at 5.28s and its fill starts at 5.335s); strokes inside a character run one after another in both passes (m: stem, then the two arches; e: crossbar, then the bowl) and the character's total time stays the same; the i-dots fill 0.28s after the heavy stroke starts; the last character is filled at 5.755s and the film cuts to the flat logo at 5.8s, 0.045s later
Style

Paper base #f3f4f6 with two multiply relief textures (256px and 1024px); ink #0d0f13, ultramarine accent #2346ff (meridian, 26, URL), guides #7d838d; a 256px grain tile jumped every frame (9% multiply, 3% screen) and a 30% vignette; date and URL Inter 500, 50px, centered (date text box top at y=600px, URL at y=680px), the URL in the accent color

The camera is a low macro with 1500px perspective, and depth of field comes from four identical copies of the plane blurred 0, 2.4, 6 and 12px with a focus band half-width of 150–330px. spec: 时长

全片 11s，镜头在 1.9s、3.4s、4.7s 硬切，5.8s 硬切到正面标志。细笔画圆环 0–2.6s（进度 55%→封口），蓝笔画经线 2.3–3.2s；10 个字符骨架 3.0–4.78s 依次起笔，间隔 0.16–0.22s，每个 0.3–0.55s。粗笔描实 4.5–5.755s，字符间隔 0.075s，每个 0.42s。正面标志 5.8–7.0s，虚化 7.0–7.9s（同时上移 90px），日期 7.75s、网址 8.15s 起逐字打出，停到 11s。0s 起纸面纹理和辅助线就在画面上，没有淡入
缓动
圆环细笔 none（匀速）；经线和字母骨架 power1.inOut；粗笔描实 power2.out；辅助线 power2.out；镜头一、二、三匀速（none），镜头四 power3.out；标志虚化 power2.inOut；日期和网址 expo.out（每字 0.5s，间隔 0.035s，同时从下方 8px 升到位，模糊 6px 变清晰）
镜头

透视 1500px，纸面绕水平轴倾斜。镜头一缩放 5.2→4.4，倾角 58°→55°，滚转 −10°→−6°，镜头对准笔尖前方 4° 弧度，笔尖停在画面中部（约 45% 高度）；镜头二缩放 2.5→2.2，倾角 50°→47°；镜头三缩放 1.9→1.75，倾角 55°→52°，镜头向右滑，对准正在画的字母左侧约 25 单位，笔尖在画面中部偏右；镜头四缩放 1.15→0.78，倾角 52°→46°，镜头向右拉远，开头标志完整在画面内，结束时 6 的右边缘离画面右边约 280px。整段另有 1.00→1.02 的慢推。景深用四份同样的画面叠加，模糊 0、2.4、6、12px，对焦带半宽 150、190、160、330px（按镜头一到四）
主体

纸面坐标 1 单位 = 2.8px，x 高度 100 单位（280px）。标志：墨色圆环加蓝色经线椭圆（半径 66、半宽 30 单位）；字标 meridian 加蓝色 26，共 10 个字符，用圆弧和直线几何构造。细笔 0.7 单位（约 2px），字母粗笔 16 单位（约 45px），圆环和经线 13 单位。辅助线共 36 条：4 条横向基准线、3 个同心圆、3 条斜线、2 条十字线、每个字符的左右边线和圆形字母的外接圆，另有基线刻度（每 6 单位）和定位十字
同步

每个字符的辅助线比骨架早 0.8–0.9s 开始画；每个字符的粗笔在它自己的骨架画完之后才开始（m 骨架 3.55s 结束，粗笔 4.66s 开始；6 骨架 5.28s 结束，粗笔 5.335s 开始）；i 的圆点在粗笔开始后 0.28s 填实；字符内的笔画依次画出（m 先竖线再两个拱，e 先横线再圆弧），骨架和粗笔都是这样，每个字符的总时长不变；最后一个字符 5.755s 描完，5.8s 硬切到正面标志，两者间隔 0.045s
风格
纸面底色 #f3f4f6，叠两层 multiply 浮雕纹理（256px 和 1024px）；墨色 #0d0f13，强调色群青 #2346ff（经线、26、网址），辅助线 #7d838d；每帧跳位的 256px 颗粒（multiply 9%、screen 3%）和 30% 暗角；日期和网址 Inter 500，50px，居中，日期文字框顶部 y=600px，网址 y=680px，网址用强调色

en.title: Line Drawing Logo Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A macro camera follows a plotter pen over textured paper as it draws a ring mark and letters, then the logo blurs and the date types on. Free recipe.
en.lede: A low macro camera follows a plotter pen across paper: it draws a ring and a meridian, sketches each letter as a skeleton, a heavy pen fills them in, then the film cuts to the flat logo, which blurs while the date and URL type on below it.
en.name: Line Drawing Logo Animation

body.h2: How to make a Line Drawing Logo Animation with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Build one paper plane (1 unit = 2.8px, x-height 100 units) that holds the whole logo as stroke paths, and draw it with stroke-dashoffset on pathLength=10000 paths (GSAP rounds CSS lengths to whole numbers, so a pathLength of 1 would make every stroke jump). A thin pen (about 2px) draws the ring from 55% to 79% in take 1 (0–1.9s), then the blue meridian ellipse takes 0.9s at 2.3s. Light gray guides (36 strokes plus baseline ticks every 6 units) sit under the pen.

Run the camera as four takes with hard cuts at 1.9s, 3.4s and 4.7s: zoom 5.2→4.4 at 58° tilt, zoom 2.5→2.2 at 50°, zoom 1.9→1.75 at 55°, then zoom 1.15→0.78 at 52°→46° with power3.out, pulling back and sliding right so the 6 ends about 280px inside the frame. Keep the pen tip near the middle of the frame: aim the camera 4° of arc ahead of the tip in take 1, and about 25 units left of the letter being drawn in take 3. The 10 letter skeletons start from 3.0s, 0.16–0.22s apart. Fake depth of field with four copies of the plane blurred 0, 2.4, 6 and 12px under screen-space masks. The heavy pen (16 units, about 45px) fills the letters from 4.66s, 0.075s apart, with the strokes inside a letter drawn one after another.

At 5.8s cut to the flat logo, 1480px wide, hold it sharp to 7.0s, then defocus it over 0.9s (blur 0→16px, opacity 1→0.18, moving up 90px). Once the defocus is done, type the date below it from 7.75s (0.035s per character, expo.out) and the URL from 8.15s, and hold both to 11s. The paper and guides are on screen from frame 0. Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard, then render an MP4 with HyperFrames.

en.alt: The logo "meridian 26" in black and blue on textured white paper.
faq: How do you make a line drawing logo animation?

Put the logo's strokes on a path, give each path a large pathLength such as 10000 and animate stroke-dashoffset from 10000 to 0 so the line grows from its start. Draw a thin skeleton first and trace a heavy stroke over it afterwards, as this film does, so the logo seems to be drawn and then inked.
How does the film fake depth of field on a drawing?

It stacks four copies of the paper plane, blurs them 0, 2.4, 6 and 12px and masks each with a soft band, so the area around the pen stays sharp while the near and far paper blur. The band is set once per take and resets at each cut, with a half-width of 150, 190, 160 and 330px.

zh.description: 微距镜头跟着绘图笔在纸面上画出圆环标志和字母，随后标志虚化，日期和网址逐字打出。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个效果。

zh.name: 线条绘制 logo 动画

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做线条绘制 logo 动画
body.body:
用一张纸面平面（1 单位 = 2.8px，x 高度 100 单位）装下整个标志的笔画路径，每条路径设 pathLength=10000，用 stroke-dashoffset 画出（GSAP 会把 CSS 长度取整，pathLength 设成 1 时笔画会直接跳出来）。镜头一（0–1.9s）细笔（约 2px）把圆环从 55% 画到 79%，2.3s 起蓝色经线椭圆用 0.9s 画完。纸上有浅灰辅助线（36 条，另有每 6 单位一个的基线刻度）。

镜头分四个机位，在 1.9s、3.4s、4.7s 硬切：缩放 5.2→4.4、倾角 58°；缩放 2.5→2.2、倾角 50°；缩放 1.9→1.75、倾角 55°；最后缩放 1.15→0.78、倾角 52°→46°，用 power3.out，镜头向右拉远，让 6 的右边缘离画面右边约 280px。笔尖保持在画面中部：镜头一把镜头对准笔尖前方 4° 弧度，镜头三把镜头对准正在画的字母左侧约 25 单位。10 个字母骨架从 3.0s 起，每隔 0.16–0.22s 起笔。景深用四份同样的纸面平面，模糊 0、2.4、6、12px，再用屏幕空间蒙版叠起来。粗笔（16 单位，约 45px）从 4.66s 起每隔 0.075s 描实一个字母，字母内的笔画依次画出。

5.8s 硬切到正面标志，宽 1480px，清晰停到 7.0s，再用 0.9s 虚化（模糊 0→16px，不透明度 1→0.18，同时上移 90px）。虚化结束后，日期从 7.75s 起在标志下方逐字打出（每字间隔 0.035s，expo.out），网址从 8.15s 起，两者都停到 11s。纸面和辅助线从第 0 帧起就在画面上。点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill，再用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4。

zh.alt: 带纹理的白纸上印着黑蓝两色的 meridian 26 标志。
faq: 线条绘制 logo 动画怎么做？
把 logo 的笔画写成路径，每条路径设一个较大的 pathLength（比如 10000），再把 stroke-dashoffset 从 10000 动画到 0，线条就从起点长出来。像这支片子一样先画细骨架、再用粗线描一遍，观众会先看到画线，再看到上墨。
这支片子怎么给线稿做景深？
把纸面平面叠成四份，分别模糊 0、2.4、6、12px，再各用一条柔和的蒙版带，笔尖附近保持清晰，近处和远处的纸面变模糊。蒙版带每个机位设置一次，在每次硬切时重设，半宽依次是 150、190、160、330px。
